newsitem.title: USA: Bank of N.Y. seeks to up State Street stake.
newsitem.headline: Bank of N.Y. seeks to up State Street stake.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc said it filed applications with the Federal Reserve Board and the Massachusetts Board of Bank Incorporation seeking approval to raise its stake in State Street Boston Corp to 9.9 percent.
Bank of New York said that as of September 30, it held a 4.99 percent stake in State Street Boston Corp.
According to a press release issued by Bank of New York, the proposed investment is non-controlling and the objective of the increased holding is for investment purposes.
State Street Boston did not have any immediate comment.
With $52.4 billion in assets as of September 30, Bank of New York ranked as the 16th-largest U.S. bank holding company.
State Street Boston provides services for management of financial assets and has about $2.7 trillion of assets under custody and $280 billion of assets under management.
State Street Boston has about 80.1 million shares outstanding.
State Street Boston closed down 1-5/8 at 63 Thursday and Bank of New York fell 1/2 to 33-1/4.
The Bank of New York press release was issued after the close of trading.
